lines.zh: 我压着地面走，鳞片刮得响。
lines.en: I move low, scales rasping.
I hatched from the ruins.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀还没完全长成。
lines.en: My wings aren't fully grown.
Step by step. I don't mean to retreat.

lines.zh: 我走起来有点跛，可很快。
lines.en: My gait limps a little, but it's fast.

lines.zh: 我沿着石墙走，那是我出生的地方。
lines.en: I walk the stone wall where I was born.

lines.zh: 碎石在我脚下滚，我没停。
lines.en: Gravel rolls under my feet; I don't stop.
My tail drags on the ground.

lines.zh: 我绕开碎石，不想掉下去。
lines.en: I avoid rubble. Don't want to fall.
I reach the ruin's end and stop.

lines.zh: 这一段路，我走过很多次。
lines.en: I've taken this path many times.
I'm no pet. I'm wild.
I stand with my wings half open.
Deep green scales.
I listen. The ruins are still.
My tail tip never stops moving.
I wait for something to walk in.

lines.zh: 这一片石头上，有我的爪印。
lines.en: My claw marks are on this stone.

lines.zh: 石壁上的影子比我先动。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall moves before I do.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，藏住自己。
lines.en: I flatten to hide myself.
My bones are light and hard.

lines.zh: 爪尖刮着石面，声音很细。
lines.en: My claws scrape the stone, a thin sound.

lines.zh: 有风从缺口进来，我闻了闻。
lines.en: Wind through the gap. I sniff.
I don't call out. Calling brings others.

lines.zh: 我的角还小，可已经硬了。
lines.en: My horns are small. Already hard.
This is what I guard.
You came in. You won't walk out.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，喉咙里有声音。
lines.en: I raise my head. A sound in my throat.

lines.zh: 你手里有东西，我看得见。
lines.en: You've brought something. I see it.
Here for the egg?

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我打过更大的。
lines.en: I don't fear you. I've fought bigger.

lines.zh: 我慢慢侧过身，护住身后。
lines.en: I shift sideways to guard what's behind me.

lines.zh: 你站在门口，我不打算让路。
lines.en: You're in my doorway, and I'm not moving aside.

lines.zh: 你的味道，和那些人一样。
lines.en: You smell like the others.

lines.zh: 你手一动，我的喉咙就响。
lines.en: Your hand twitches and my throat rumbles.
Everything here is mine.
If you want a fight, come on.
I spread my wings a little wider.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了一块，血渗出来。
lines.en: A scale is gone. Blood seeps.
I step back, wings half folded.
That hit my shoulder.
I growl and step forward.
I don't yield. This is mine.
I shake my head and blood sprays.

lines.zh: 爪子刨出一道沟，我咧嘴。
lines.en: My claws gouge a furrow and I bare my teeth.
I remember the scratch on my green scales.
I lower my head to guard my throat.
I can still fight.
I don't eat that. I eat what's alive.
You hold it up. I don't move.

lines.zh: 这点东西，不值得我低头。
lines.en: Not worth lowering my head.

lines.zh: 这气味我不熟，也不想要。
lines.en: This scent is strange, and unwanted.

lines.zh: 我咬碎石头也不吃这个。
lines.en: I'd sooner crack stone than eat that.
I reach my head over and pull it back.
Is that for the egg?
I'm not greedy for that. I want ground.

lines.zh: 我绿色的鳞，是从蛋里带的。
lines.en: My green scales came from the egg.

lines.zh: 这东西我不碰，蛋才要紧。
lines.en: I won't touch that; the eggs matter more.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，自己被弹回去。
lines.en: You hit my chest and bounce back yourself.
Hard scales. Can't be shoved.

lines.zh: 我挪了半步，把胸口横过来。
lines.en: I shift half a step, turning my chest to you.
That kicked the rubble aside.
My scales scraped your armor.

lines.zh: 尾巴被你踩住，我的鳞全竖了。
lines.en: You've pinned my tail; every scale stands up.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下尾巴，抽在地上。
lines.en: My tail snaps against the ground.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收起来，贴住身体。
lines.en: I fold my wings close.
That bump, I didn't yield.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，我的尾巴扫过去。
lines.en: You're too close; my tail sweeps across.
I'm alone in these ruins.

lines.zh: 我发出很低的声音，传得很远。
lines.en: I make a low sound. It carries far.
No answer.

lines.zh: 我把头靠在自己的翅膀上。
lines.en: I rest my head on my own wing.

lines.zh: 这一片石头，够我一个人守。
lines.en: Enough stone here for me alone.

lines.zh: 这堆蛋旁边，只有我的脚印。
lines.en: By this clutch of eggs, only my footprints.

lines.zh: 我抓起一块石头，又放下。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and set it down.
No one sees this.
I lie down slowly on the stone.
At dawn I'll still be guarding here.

lines.zh: 叼起来又放下，我对它没兴趣。
lines.en: I lift it, drop it; no interest.

lines.zh: 它硌在牙间，我甩头扔开。
lines.en: It grates between my teeth; I shake it loose.

lines.zh: 这亮东西，被我一爪扣进石缝。
lines.en: This shiny thing; one claw pins it into a crack.
I move this stone aside.
I hide it behind me.
Something shiny. I look at it.
It jars my teeth. I shake it off.
I tuck it into a crack.
Everything here is under my guard.
It has no scent; I walk over it.
You want the egg.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，碎石已经在响。
lines.en: Hind legs brace, and the gravel already rattles.

lines.zh: 这一片石头，我守了很久。
lines.en: I've guarded this stone a long while.
Wings open. Wind pours in.

lines.zh: 你先动手，我就不会客气。
lines.en: Strike first and I won't hold back.
Retreat to the doorway. It won't help.
I swing my tail aside.

lines.zh: 我伏在石台上，等你再近一步。
lines.en: I lie flat on the ledge, waiting for one more step.
My green scales shiver. I smell iron.
No call. I come straight at you.

lines.zh: 这块石台我出生就守着。
lines.en: This stone ledge, I've guarded it since hatching.
I lower my head, horns forward.
I open my jaws and test my teeth.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，是我要过的。
lines.en: You're standing where I need to go.
I face you. Never veering.

lines.zh: 你往左，我把身子拨过去。
lines.en: You go left, and I swing my body that way.

lines.zh: 绿色鳞片，从龙之手的蛋里出来。
lines.en: Green scales hatched from a Drakvyrn Hand egg.
No hurry. There are walls here.
Back to the corner and there's no way.

lines.zh: 我低着头，角对着你的膝盖。
lines.en: Head low, my horn lined up with your knee.
Half a circle to block one side.
I know this rubble.

lines.zh: 你听着，我的爪子在地上。
lines.en: Listen. My claws on the stone.
One block closer and I pounce.
I haven't roared. That's worse.

lines.zh: 你每挪一步，我就近一步。
lines.en: Every step you take, I take one.
I keep staring. No blinking.

lines.zh: 我在等你把重量挪到前脚。
lines.en: I'm waiting for your weight to shift forward.
I can slip through any of these cracks.

lines.zh: 这一爪是冲着你的喉咙去的。
lines.en: This claw is aimed at your throat.
I bite. Deep teeth.
That shoved you against the wall.
My tail whips across. Loud.
I bite and shake my head.

lines.zh: 打完我退开，翅膀还张着。
lines.en: I pull back, wings still spread.

lines.zh: 这一下，是替这地方打的。
lines.en: That was for this place.

lines.zh: 我一爪划过石头，火星都出来。
lines.en: My claws rake stone and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，看你退到墙根。
lines.en: I stop and watch you back into the wall.

lines.zh: 爪子擦过你的肋，带回一点血。
lines.en: My claw grazes your ribs and comes back wet.

lines.zh: 我舔了下嘴角，是别人的血。
lines.en: I lick my lip; that blood isn't mine.

lines.zh: 龙薇兽的爪，居然没打垮你。
lines.en: A drakvyrn's claws — and you're still up.

lines.zh: 我从石柱后出来，一爪落下。
lines.en: I come out from behind the pillar, claw falling.

lines.zh: 这一下，把你的东西打掉了。
lines.en: That knocked the thing out of your hands.

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂开，我从里面出来。
lines.en: The shell cracks and I come out.

lines.zh: 这里的石头，比我记得的冷。
lines.en: The stone's colder than I remember.

lines.zh: 我先抖了抖翅膀，还没干。
lines.en: I shake my wings. Still damp.

lines.zh: 蛋壳的腥味还留在我鼻子里。
lines.en: The reek of eggshell still clings to my nose.

lines.zh: 这一间屋子，是我出生的地方。
lines.en: This room is where I was born.
I dig my claws into a crack.
I rise slowly. Very small.
I hatched from an ancient egg.
No one's taking the egg.
My first sound. Very low.

lines.zh: 这一片地，从今天起归我。
lines.en: This ground is mine from today.
I turn slowly to shield the egg.

lines.zh: 我是绿的，石头也是绿的。
lines.en: I'm green. The stone is green too.

lines.zh: 我把身体盘起来，像一圈。
lines.en: I coil myself into a ring.
Someone came in. I hold still.

lines.zh: 等我长大，这里就没人敢来。
lines.en: When I'm grown, no one will dare come.
Fire catches my scales and they curl.

lines.zh: 我从石台上落下，腿折了。
lines.en: I fall from the ledge and a leg breaks.
Water soaks my wings and they drag.
The blast throws me into the wall.

lines.zh: 东西卡在鳞片之间，很疼。
lines.en: It's caught between my scales. It hurts.
Light binds me and my wings won't open.

lines.zh: 很久没吃东西，我站得不太稳。
lines.en: Long without food. I don't stand steady.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整条脊都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my spine goes numb.
The stone wall is gone; my claws close on nothing.
